context:
Goal: waiting-page rows with a press button stay readable at narrow widths and with large text.
Problem (goal): at 280, 240 and 180 CSS px the text column in a press row shrinks to 66, 26 and 3 px, and "Add to list" overlaps "Send ask". Text sizes are in px, so browser text zoom does not make them bigger.
Based on (measured): the designer's headless runs on main plus #2253.
Departs from: page.html press rows in px, with a 600px parked-line breakpoint — row text moves to rem at the same sizes, the breakpoint moves to 37.5rem, and below 19.5em the press button drops under the text.
Meanwhile: the lane builds option a. Not blocking.

options.gain: The text column stays at least 8em wide down to 240 px. At 1440, 820, 390 and 360 px nothing changes.
